WITH obs_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telesc_count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) as share
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
avg_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_val
  FROM obs_counts
),
above_avg_obs AS (
  SELECT 
    oc.telesc_count,
    oc.share,
    a.avg_share_val
  FROM obs_counts oc
  CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc a
  WHERE oc.share > a.avg_share_val
)
SELECT 
  AVG(telesc_count) as avg_telescope_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share_val) as avg_share_excess
FROM above_avg_obs;
